2.3 SWS_COMManager
[constr_SWS_ComM_CONSTR_00001] ⌈ComM channel’s that are referenced by a
PNC are not allowed to be referenced by any ComMUsers, if the PNC references at
least one EthIfSwitchPortGroup (see figure [REF] Use Case 6). A configuration tool
shall reject such a configuration as invalid (error). This constraint is only valid for a
host ecu that control an Ethernet switch. In all other UseCases ComMChannels can
be referenced by a PNC’s and ComMUsers.
⌋()
